body: Fix `SimTracer` so tick numbering is monotonic even after `drain_ticks()`. In `crates/tank_core/src/tracing.rs:336-345`, `tick_index` is derived from `self.ticks.len()`, so draining the in-memory buffer causes later ticks to restart at 0. A long-running harness that periodically drains memory will therefore emit duplicate tick ids in its JSONL stream even though the simulation kept advancing. Keep a separate counter for the next tick id instead of tying ids to the retained buffer length.
